request.text:
<restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: sad.> We took the bridge back. The captain hasn't said a word since. Neither have I.
<long pause>
<restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: idle.> Captain made peace with them. Some of the lads don't like it. I like breathing.
<long pause>
<restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: idle.> Orders are to watch the docks now. Watch them for what, nobody says.
<long pause>
<restrained, ashamed but loyal military voice Mood: idle.> Long shift, cold boots. Same as every week.
